content.title: Kura Sushi’s (NASDAQ:KRUS) Q3 Sales Beat Estimates
content.summary: Sushi restaurant chain Kura Sushi (NASDAQ:KRUS) reported Q3 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 20.4% year on year to $79.45 million. On the other hand, the company’s full-year revenue guidance of $332 million at the midpoint came in 1.9% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.20 per share was 63.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
